cuts.scene: At the entrance of a science-fiction costume exhibition she carries a tray of silk wrist ribbons for guests; warm spotlights cross the terrazzo floor and a geometric display arch.
cuts.outfit: A fitted navy vest worn open over a cropped pale-yellow tank and a yellow pleated miniskirt shows shoulders, midriff and thighs; a ribbon tag and lanyard complete the event costume.
cuts.example_text: an event staff costume with a fitted vest, name-tag ribbon, and lanyard, at a themed venue

cuts.scene: Warm paper lanterns hang above a stone footbridge; she carries a grilled berry skewer while strolling past the glowing reflections.
cuts.outfit: A slate-blue halter short jumpsuit with a deep open back and side waist cutouts exposes back, waist and thighs; two fine golden bands trim the bodice.
cuts.example_text: Walking through a lantern festival with a small snack, wearing comfortable event clothing with subtle Pokémon motifs.

cuts.scene: At a pottery wheel in an afternoon ceramics class she smooths the rim of a small wet clay bowl, a sponge and clay tools on the shelf beside her.
cuts.outfit: A short rust-colored apron over a low-backed charcoal tank and yellow wrap miniskirt leaves shoulders, back and thighs exposed.
